cases.name: Jennifer Dulos
cases.narrative: Her blood was found in several locations where her estranged husband and his girlfriend were videotaped disposing of trash bags. Blood spatter and evidence of cleanup attempts were also found at her New Canaan home. She remains missing after her May 24 disappearance.

cases.name: Laura Williams
cases.about: Her brother David Williams said she was a multi-faceted, "driven" woman who had a talent for writing and pursued many interests. Laura grew up in Charlottesville, Va., and graduated from a public high school there, her brother said. She received a scholarship to play lacrosse and field hockey at the University of Virginia, he said, but moved after one year to the University of Pennsylvania. She attended one semester there before finishing her college education at Georgetown University in Washington, D.C., where she received a bachelor's degree in foreign relations in 1993. His sister was a talented writer and artist, Williams said. Out of college, she worked as an editor for a movie production company in Los Angeles before moving to New York City, where she worked as an importer for the Seagram Company, he said. She met Sebastian's father, restaurateur Dirk Van Stockum, in the city, but they never married, David Williams said. Laura Williams later married Kevin Gahwyler, but they divorced about six years ago and had no children, Gahwyler said Monday. He also used the term "driven" to describe his ex-wife, along with "talented." Both he and David Williams said Laura Williams had been working out of her New Canaan home selling high-end antiques at the time of her death.
